renderer: Local Three.js GLTFLoader/WebGLRenderer in Edge headless; source GLB mesh, UV and PBR materials loaded without modification. PNG alpha rendering, orthographic front camera for meter; slight oblique camera for memory objects. Transparent border trimmed, 16px padding.
presentationLighting: RoomEnvironment PMREM, hemisphere and directional lights; ACES filmic tone mapping exposure 1.5. Camera, exposure and studio lighting are presentation choices, not a claim of matching original AR lighting.
meterReadout: Original mesh/UV/material render visibly reads 1.703129. No digits were typed, replaced, painted, or synthesized.
memoryNotes: Both recovered scene-specific memory GLBs are rendered separately; original bright nested pyramid geometry and materials preserved.
